assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game asset atlas for a chibi witch arena bullet-hell in Unity. Square PNG, exactly 2 by 2 equal square cells, read order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Four separate isolated sprite assets, ONE per cell. Transparent RGBA background throughout, no drawn grid or borders, no text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no UI frames, no scenery. Every object centered precisely in its own cell and contained within the central 70 percent of cell width and height, ample transparent gutters; no touching adjacent cell. Polished clean hand-drawn anime cel-shaded game VFX, bold simple shapes readable at small size, bright white cores and crisp colored outlines, tightly restrained glow, no broad haze. Assets share same style but each cell has its prescribed distinct silhouette. Directional projectiles point straight UP (+Y), centered luminous core, not tilted. Effect artwork is static, NOT four animation frames. Skill: MAGIC HOMING MISSILES, palette violet and lavender with ivory-white cores. TOP LEFT: HUD icon showing exactly FIVE small violet magic missiles fanning upward, a clear compact fan-shaped symbol. TOP RIGHT: ONE magic missile projectile, an elongated faceted violet magic dart with sharp white crystalline nose at top and two short swept lavender fins and a short curved flame tail below; noticeably stronger and wider than a normal bullet; not a mechanical rocket. BOTTOM LEFT: compact on-hit VFX, a sharp six-point violet-white magical spark, empty transparent space between short rays. BOTTOM RIGHT: Lv5 small radial detonation VFX, a broken lavender circular shock ring with a small white central star and sparse violet shards, mostly transparent interior. No gold, no fire, no ice. Exactly four distinct assets, consistent clean matching game art.
